name: zama-ai/tfhe-rs
description: A pure Rust implementation of the TFHE scheme for boolean and integer fully homomorphic encryption, with APIs in Rust, C, and WebAssembly. Targets IND-CPA^D security and achieved v1.0 stable in 2025.
score_rationale: Strong Rust FHE implementation with 1.6k stars and a 2025 stable release, backed by Zama AI and actively used in privacy-preserving computation applications.
